# Write workspace text (workspace.write)

## categories

[
  "workspace",
  "files"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "bytes_written": 18,
      "path": "notes/hello.txt"
    },
    "id": "basic",
    "input": {
      "path": "notes/hello.txt",
      "text": "Hello laboratory!\n"
    },
    "title": "Basic invocation in an empty workspace"
  }
]

## description

Creates parent directories and a new UTF-8 file. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true. Returns the relative path and byte count. Does not execute the text.

## failure_modes

[
  {
    "condition": "Invalid arguments or unavailable resource.",
    "recovery": "Check the schema, permissions and relative path.",
    "symptom": "A validation or capability error."
  }
]

## limitations

[
  "No network access or code execution.",
  "Forward-slash relative paths only; traversal, absolute paths, links and Windows special names are refused.",
  "Process-tier path checks are not an OS sandbox; concurrent path replacement is not contained.",
  "At most 250000 Unicode characters per call. Writes are not atomic; interrupted writes may be partial."
]
